artboards.title: The Path — one step per post

annotations.text:
01 and 06 are built on the real avatar and are safe to post.

02 to 05 are NOT. AOV / CAC / LTV and "it's not traffic, it's math" were written for experienced operators, before the avatar was known. A complete beginner working shifts does not know those acronyms and will read them as "not for me". Re-cut them before using.

VALUE FIRST - nothing on this page sells anything.

No DM keyword, no offer, no price. Every post ends on SAVE, SHARE or FOLLOW, because those are the three actions that build an audience. The outlined button marks a value post; the solid one is only for the launch post on page 1.

The disclaimer is gone from these too - it belongs on posts that make a claim, and these make none.

RUN THEM IN THIS ORDER.

1. Red flags - leads with protection, not promotion. "I sell one of these, hold me to all four" is the line that earns the follow.
2. Honest cost - sets expectations before anyone can feel misled later.
3. The Path - proves a real system exists. One step per post, as many posts as the path has steps.
4. Myth / Truth - one objection per post, drawn from what people actually reply.
5. Real Talk - use sparingly. It loses force if it becomes weekly.

RULES THAT KEEP THIS HONEST

Never invent a figure - not in a myth, not in a cost, not in a Real Talk quote. The whole position is that this business does not promise a number.

Teach the thing completely. A value post that stops halfway to make you DM is an ad, and this audience can tell.

Top and bottom 250px stay clear for Instagram's profile row and reply bar.
